notes: Spec sheet and rear-panel photo (AJA official product page PDF) were used together. The SDI I/O is split into 4 fixed BNC 3G-SDI ports and 4 SFP-cage ports that can be populated with either a 12G/6G-SDI BNC (HD-BNC) coax module or a 12G/6G/3G-SDI fiber module (dual/single LC, or single SC for 3G) — modeled as bnc with accepts:[fiber-lc] and grade sdi-12g since that is the SFP module's top-rated mode; actual grade depends on which SFP module is installed. AES audio I/O and GPI both use 25-pin D-sub connectors, which are not in the provided connector list; euroblock/rs232 were chosen only as nearest available ids and are not physically accurate (documented in each port's note). MADI in/out are combined BNC+ST-fiber pairs (physical fiber connector is ST, not LC; fiber-lc used as nearest allowed id). Two IEC power inlets are redundant (device runs on either, not simultaneously required). Full spec sheet also confirms genlock, ancillary data, and HDR/WCG processing features not relevant to physical I/O.

ports.name: SDI In 5-8 (SFP)
ports.note: 4x optional SFP cage inputs: 12G/6G-SDI BNC (HD-BNC) coax module or 12G/6G/3G-SDI fiber module (dual/single LC or SC)

ports.name: SDI Out 5-8 (SFP)
ports.note: 4x optional SFP cage outputs: 12G/6G-SDI BNC (HD-BNC) coax module or 12G/6G/3G-SDI fiber module (dual/single LC or SC)

ports.name: Ref In
ports.note: External reference, looping/non-terminating, blackburst or tri-level sync

ports.name: Ref Loop Through
ports.note: Reference video loop-through of Ref In

ports.name: AES Audio In
ports.note: DB-25 connector, 8x balanced AES inputs (16 channels), AES-3. DB-25 not in allowed list; closest analog multi-pin audio connector chosen — physically a 25-pin D-sub, not euroblock.

ports.name: AES Audio Out
ports.note: DB-25 connector, 8x balanced AES outputs (16 channels), AES-3. DB-25 not in allowed list; closest analog multi-pin audio connector chosen — physically a 25-pin D-sub, not euroblock.

ports.name: MADI In
ports.note: MADI input pair: 1x BNC (coax) + 1x ST fiber; AES-10, 128 channels

ports.name: MADI Out
ports.note: MADI output pair: 1x BNC (coax) + 1x ST fiber; AES-10, 128 channels

ports.name: LAN
ports.note: 10/100/1000 Ethernet, embedded web server, REST, SNMP

ports.name: GPI
ports.note: 1x 25-pin D-connector; 4 optically isolated GPI inputs + 4 optically isolated GPO outputs. 25-pin D-sub not in allowed list; closest control-connector id chosen.
